title: Agentic4PDM: Host-Governed Evidence Admissibility for Industrial Fault Diagnosis

claim.summary: Agentic4PDM has role-separated LLM agents compare a sensor window with one labelled reference per class, then a Judge requests property-indexed signal-analysis tools while a deterministic Host gates requests, assigns evidence roles by reference preflight and admits the final fault class.

modules.name: Contract-checked gated adjudication
modules.scope_reason: Request admission, reference preflight and finalization are defined over candidate fault classes and labelled class references, so the protocol is tied to the classification output contract.
